info.label: Epic
info.desc: Thriller is the sixth studio album by American recording artist Michael Jackson. The album was released on November 30, 1982 by Epic Records as the follow-up to Jackson's critically and commercially successful 1979 album Off the Wall. Thriller explores similar genres to those of Off The Wall, including funk, disco, soul, soft rock, jazz and pop. However, Thriller's lyrics deal with generally darker themes, including paranoia and the supernatural. It is also the best-selling album of all time. With a production budget of $750,000, recording sessions took place between April and November 1982 at Westlake Recording Studios in Los Angeles, .

podcast.body: *Thriller*, acknowledged as one of the best and the most sold albums in history, was a product of Michael Jackson's extraordinarily demanding and professional work ethic, not solely his immense talent. The recording process for *Thriller* involved assembling an elite team, including over 50 of the best musicians, important rock artists, and direct collaborations with figures like Eddie Van Halen and Paul McCartney, all under the guidance of Quincy Jones. "Michael Jackson grabó el thriller gracias a un trabajo durísimo y terriblemente profesional que le permitió llegar a esos niveles de calidad."

podcast.body: Despite the immense effort and resources invested in recording *Thriller*, Michael Jackson was initially dissatisfied with the results, feeling the songs were not "good enough" or even "bad." He and Quincy Jones spent an entire extra week remixing every song on the album from scratch. Even after this extensive rework, Jackson remained unconvinced of the album's perfection, ultimately releasing it without his full satisfaction. "Michael Jackson terminó sacando el disco sin estar convencido de que fue ese suficientemente bueno para lo que quería hacer."

podcast.body: For the *Thriller* album, Michael Jackson assembled an elite team, including over 50 of the best musicians available at the moment, important rock artists, and directly called upon Eddie Van Halen and Paul McCartney. He also relied on Quincy Jones, described as the best producer of Black music in history. Despite recording up to 30 songs, Jackson was so demanding that he felt none were good enough, ultimately selecting only nine tracks for the final album. "Michael Jackson para hacer el thriller cogió a más de 50 músicos que eran casi los mejores músicos que había en el momento. Me refiero cogió músicos ellas, importantes, cogió artistas de rock, importantes, incluso llamó al mismísimo Eddie Van Halen, llamó Paul McCartney, me refiero ser rodeo de lo mejor que pudo encontrar."

podcast.body: The release of *Thriller* marked a pivotal moment, officially commencing the era of mainstream pop music and mass-market pop stars, preceding the emergence of other major pop figures like Madonna. Michael Jackson reinvented numerous aspects that would define pop music moving forward, from dance choreography to music videos and large-scale concert performances. "el pop de gran consumo o la época gradada de la música pop empieza oficialmente con el thriller, poco después empezaría a venir las grandes super estrellas del pop vendría madona, vendría a todas las grandes estrellas del pop, Michael Jackson abrió una nueva manera de hacer el pop de gran consumo."
